$comment: Spelling a lexical form (docs/rules-design.md; docs/rules/yue.md): a set's members matched as ranges, on an invented statement (spell/fixture).

vectors.note: A set is matched as ranges of consecutive code points (a range, a single, a pair, a range beyond the BMP): the members and only they, as one escape each would match them. d, f, U+20003 and i are outside the set.
A large set (two whole blocks of ideographs, one beyond the BMP) in a rule's context and its find: U+4E00, U+20001 and U+9FFF, a range's first, inner and last members, are all matched.
